subject: maths
question: 15 men can complete a work in 25 days, and 25 women can complete the same work in 40 days. If all 15 men and 25 women work together, in how many days will the work get completed?
solution:
**Given:**

15 men can complete a work = 25 days

25 women can complete the same work = 40 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of a man = M

The efficiency of a woman = W

According to the question:

⇒ 15 × M × 25 = 25 × W × 40

⇒ M/W
